title: Evaluation of a padded circuit family
statement: Let $\ell:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $\ell(n)\le n$ for every $n$, and let $F_n$ be a Boolean function on assignments to the first $\ell(n)$ inputs. For every $n$ and every assignment $x$ to $n$ inputs, the padded circuit for $F_n$ evaluates to $F_n$ on the restriction of $x$ to its first $\ell(n)$ inputs.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell$ maps natural numbers to natural numbers
For every $n$, $F_n$ is a Boolean function on assignments to $\ell(n)$ inputs
$x$ is a Boolean assignment to $n$ inputs
